name: Ostkustleden Etapp 5, Mörtfors - Stjärneberg
description: Mörtfors to Stjärneberg. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
waterSources: No verified potable water source is listed for this section; carry water and treat natural water.
notes: Naturkartan page/API says 21.4 km, official PDF and Döderhult say about 19 km, rules lane found an 18.3 km Naturkartan text variant, OSM says 19 km, Pacer says about 18.5 km, and repaired official GPX is 18.734 km.
Official GPX/API includes two duplicate short Mörtfors-side lines and a reversed main line; raw summing creates the 21.4 km distance.
Naturkartan route-page marker 57.5434451248887,16.4808952113779 is about 2.16 km straight-line from the Mörtfors cabin and corresponds to the duplicated GPX junction.

The original Etapp 5 synthesis recorded a closure/bed-bug notice, while Etapp 6 lanes and a direct follow-up check of the current Stjärneberg Naturkartan page on 2026-04-29 did not reproduce any visible closure notice.
The original Etapp 5 synthesis recorded an arsenic warning, while Etapp 6 lanes and a direct follow-up check of the current Stjärneberg Naturkartan page on 2026-04-29 found boil-water wording only.
Snäckedal is an official POI on/near the trail, but Länsstyrelsen says car visitors cannot currently be directed there due to no access-road/parking agreement.

facilities.name: Övernattningsstuga Mörtfors
facilities.description: Shared Etapp 4/5 endpoint cabin in former bathhouse with kitchen, five bedrooms and toilet beside house. No fireplace and no outdoor fires. Official page notes damp smell after old water damage.

facilities.name: Parkering Mörtfors östra
facilities.description: Free parking by the Etapp 4/5 overnight hut.

facilities.name: Parkering Mörtfors västra
facilities.description: Free parking for Etapp 4 and Etapp 5; avoid blocking properties or roads.

facilities.name: Snäckedal bronsåldersgravar
facilities.description: Bronze-age grave field with information boards. Länsstyrelsen says the route passes it and visitors with cars cannot currently be directed there because there is no access-road/parking agreement.

facilities.name: Övernattningsstuga Stjärneberg
facilities.description: Etapp 5/6 endpoint. Current official page text checked on 2026-04-29 lists a two-room cottage plus smaller cabin, electricity, hotplate, iron stove, indoor fireplace, woodshed, dry toilet and a well about 75 m away. Do not hard-code a closed status; verify availability at publication time.

facilities.name: Tenting at Stjärneberg hut
facilities.description: Official cabin page lists standard tenting fee of 50 SEK/person by the cabin; verify current availability and local restrictions at publication time.

facilities.name: Stjärneberg dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet on the farm/yard is listed in current official cabin text; exact separate coordinate not found.

facilities.name: Parkering Stjärneberg
facilities.description: Free parking at Etapp 5/6 hut, but only two spaces; overflow is directed to Klintemåla.
